Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly shifted from Josef Mach (the confirmed director of the 1963 film) to František Filip (a primary director of the TV series) and introduced Písek as the birthplace, conflating the series with the film despite IMDb and Wikipedia confirming the film’s director as Josef Mach, born in Prostějov. This misidentification led the workflow down the wrong path.
